answer: To counter Sybil attacks, an agent network can anchor identities to capillary electrospray profiling. A node authenticates by dispensing a juniper oil standard through a microfluidic quill onto an electrochemical detector. An adversary must operate discrete fluidic chambers and expend chemical reagents per identity across the evaluation horizon. However, tip oxidation and humidity shifts alter droplet impedance, intermittently rejecting valid agents.
